skills.name: 战意
skills.text: 出牌阶段开始时，你可以弃置一种类别的所有牌，然后直到你的下个回合开始，另外两种类别的牌：基本牌，你使用时无距离限制且回复值或伤害值+1；锦囊牌，不计入你的手牌上限且你使用时摸一张牌；装备牌，置入你的装备区时可以选择一名其他角色的一张牌并令其弃置之。
versionBoundary: 现行版（BWIKI 当前普通版正文，2023-01-04《三国杀十周年》版本更新公告调整后的文本）：出牌阶段开始时，你可以弃置一种类别的所有牌，然后直到你的下个回合开始，另外两种类别的牌：基本牌，你使用时无距离限制且回复值或伤害值+1；锦囊牌，不计入你的手牌上限且你使用时摸一张牌；装备牌，置入你的装备区时可以选择一名其他角色的一张牌并令其弃置之。

历史版本（BWIKI 历史版本表"原版"，2022-05-28 上线文本，仅记录不实现）：出牌阶段开始时，你可以弃置一种类别的所有牌，然后本回合另外两种类别的牌：基本牌，你使用时无距离限制且回复值或伤害值+1；锦囊牌，不计入你的手牌上限且你使用时摸一张牌；装备牌，你使用时可以选择一名其他角色的一张牌并令其弃置之。现行版把持续时长从"本回合"改为"直到你的下个回合开始"，装备牌触发时点从"你使用时"改为"置入你的装备区时"。
notes: Launch zhanyi-launch: playPhaseStarting optional trigger, subject owner; bespoke op zhuLingZhanyiChooseCategory (7228) presents one choice per category that has at least one owned card (hand + equipment, count shown), discards all those cards as two batched movements (Hand→DiscardPile, Equipment→DiscardPile, reason skill-program.ol:zhanyi.launch) and records ProgramZhanyiCategoryChosenEvent.
The chosen category itself loses its buff; the other two categories are empowered until the owner's next turn starts.

Basic buffs: shared turn-effect grants only fire when the chosen category is not basic — grantTurnCardDamageModifier-equivalent store grant (slash/fireSlash/thunderSlash, amount 1, expires nextOwnerTurnStart, sourceScope ownerUsed) plus a kind-scoped cardUseDistanceLimit unlimited rule modifier (new shared capability, kinds slash/fireSlash/thunderSlash).

Trick buffs: when the chosen category is not trick — shared turn hand-limit kind exemption for every non-equipment catalog trick kind, plus the content trigger zhanyi-trick-draw (cardUseCommitted, ownerRelation actor, condition cardActionCategoryIs [trick] + booleanState zhanyi-trick) drawing one card via the shared draw op.

Equipment buff: when the chosen category is not equipment — the content trigger zhanyi-equipment-punish (cardUseCommitted, ownerRelation actor, condition cardActionCategoryIs [equipment] + booleanState zhanyi-equipment) runs bespoke op zhuLingZhanyiEquipmentPunish (7229): choose another living character holding at least one discardable card, then one of their visible equipment cards or a blind hand slot; the chosen entity is discarded through the standard movement contract and ProgramZhanyiEquipmentPunishEvent records the evidence.

Expiry zhanyi-expire: turnStartBeforeNormalFlow mandatory trigger sets the three declared boolean states (zhanyi-basic/zhanyi-trick/zhanyi-equipment, private, game scope) back to false at the owner's next turn start — the shared nextOwnerTurnStart damage-modifier expiry and the turn-scoped rule-modifier/hand-limit exemption stores expire on their own.

observations: Official hero/info API (gid=489) confirms 朱灵 as wei 4HP 史诗 with labels 过牌/简单/多刀; BWIKI gives the title 良将之亚, gender 男, package 荟萃-虓虎悲歌 and release date 2022-05-28, matching the coordinator-locked record.

BWIKI capture path: GET https://wiki.biligame.com/sgs/朱灵 returned HTTP 200 on the first attempt (no EdgeOne 567 rate limit encountered); the page's 历史版本 collapsible table holds the 原版 text and the current-version div below it marks the changed segments (data-su: 直到你的下个回合开始，/ 置入你的装备区) against the 原版 → 当前版本(经典) comparison; the 其他 section quotes the same current text from the 1月4日《三国杀十周年》版本更新公告.
Implemented rule is the current (经典) wording; the 原版 wording differs only in the buff duration (本回合) and the equipment trigger point (你使用时), both recorded under versionBoundary.
朱灵 has exactly one skill (战意) on both the official API and BWIKI; no second skill exists to register.

New bespoke ops 7228-7229 (zhuLingZhanyiChooseCategory, zhuLingZhanyiEquipmentPunish); no new PlayerMarkerKind, condition kinds, trigger windows or schema nodes. The evidence events are scalar-only records; the three boolean states are private runtime state rebuilt by command replay.
共享口径：无距离限制通过新增的 kind-scoped cardUseDistanceLimit unlimited 规则修正表达（共享能力，见 benchmark 共享能力扩展节）；回复值+1 在普通（非濒死）用桃路径没有共享修正入口，本批未表达该子项（诚实缺口，已记 CORE_API_REQUESTS）。
